pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/shell/Poster.tsx:131 The shell wraps lazy-loaded section components in a Suspense boundary with a null fallback and no error boundary or retry wrapper, causing chunk load failures to crash the entire application into a blank screen.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/shell/Shell.tsx:142 The layer-2 Suspense fallback lacks a warm-path delay and the shell provides no ErrorBoundary or retry mechanism to catch chunk load failures.
apps/console/src/shell/MixerBus.tsx:35 Active state is derived directly from the current route without storing duplicate active flags on navigation entries.
apps/console/src/shell/Shell.tsx:143 The shell constrains navigation depth to two levels by hosting nested layer-2 pages in a section-scoped spread and delegating deeper sub-paths to the page.
apps/console/src/shell/Chrome.tsx:12 The shell chrome hosts persistent connection monitoring above the content viewport across all page navigations.

pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/app/App.tsx:10 The root application composition mounts the shell and its code-split page registry without an error boundary or chunk retry handler, causing chunk loading failures to unmount the entire application.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/app/pages.ts:10 The bootstrap registry defines pages using lazy-loaded chunks but provides no chunk retry wrapper or error recovery boundary at the app level.
apps/console/src/app/App.tsx:8 Session-lifetime singleton services (router and data layer) are mounted at the root above the shell where they survive all navigations.
apps/console/src/keys/keymap.ts:52 The global keyboard map enforces navigation hierarchy traversal by binding Escape to climb from layer 2 to layer 1 and stopping at the wall.
